## Provider integration (complete only when applicable)

See the [provider-integration preflight](../docs/architecture/provider-integration-preflight.md).

- [ ] Capability Contract records provider/version, official sources, trust and identity boundary, and zero-mutation invalid-input proof.
- [ ] Stack Dependency Map was completed before the first stack PR.
- [ ] Architecture/security preflight evidence is recorded.
- [ ] Exact worktree, HEAD/base, changed manifest, and frozen candidate evidence are recorded.
- [ ] Verifier and applicable CARE evidence match the frozen candidate.
- [ ] Platform guarantees and unresolved limits are recorded.
- [ ] No absent or undocumented upstream capability is being substituted; dependent work is stopped if one exists.
